title: Add remote registry mirror UX design
verified: Remote registry mirrors are explicitly optional future UX and not baseline authority.
Pinned local registry snapshot, local lockfile, staged set, active set and local replay evidence remain the ecosystem source of truth.
Mirror states are defined as not-configured, available, stale, failed, untrusted and disabled.
Expired local snapshots remain fail-closed unless a future explicit refresh PlanRun is approved and implemented.
Mirror trust, endpoint identity, signature status, signer key id, channel, trust tier, provenance, SBOM and revocation status must be visible.
Network or mirror failure does not break local baseline operation when the pinned local snapshot is fresh.
Future refresh must stage inertly, run ecosystem replay and commit only through SecurityExecutionEngine.

risk_notes: Remote mirror refresh execution remains unimplemented and intentionally projection-only in Console Beta.
Network remains optional; local pinned snapshots remain sufficient for baseline operation while fresh.
Mirror inconsistencies, signature failures and trust failures must block refresh instead of silently overriding local evidence.
